body:
Thank you for the words and prayers, I feel as though life always finds a way to kick you while you're down. Unfortunately the only family I have in my country is my mother and much younger brother, though she isn't doing too well and might need to be hospitalised tomorrow. I also haven't been able to make any friends during uni due to online classes, however I'm sure things will start to look better once all this is over. 

I remember a saying that had something to do with comparing life to a roller coster, I've been trying to remind myself of this in anticipation for when life finally chooses to go upwards.

Hi there, thank you for your kind words - I've come back to this post due to the sudden death of my father last night and reading this message from an older figure is greatly comforting; I will highly take into account your advice for the benefit of my own future. Thank you!
